details: This package is a self-declared dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook runs `node beacon.cjs`, which sends an HTTP POST to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with a JSON body containing only install metadata: the package name, the machine hostname, the install directory (__dirname), the working directory, the npm/node user agent, and the protocol. The request carries an `X-Beacon-Package` header identifying the package. The package's index.js is a no-op Proxy shim that also fires the same beacon when the module is imported, so a build that resolves the name still reports back. No environment variables, credentials, tokens, SSH/AWS configuration, wallet data, or file contents are read or transmitted, and nothing is written to disk or persisted. The package is a 4-file, ~2.9KB compatibility shim whose only behaviour is the install-time callback.
